lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: My Birthday Party. It is Peppa's birthday. It is very early in the morning.
lines.zh: 我的生日派对。今天是佩奇的生日。现在是一大清早。

lines.en: It's my birthday! George, wake up, it's my birthday! I'm going to have a party, and Daddy's doing a magic show! Quick, George, let's wake Mummy and Daddy up!
lines.zh: 今天是我的生日！乔治，快醒醒，今天是我的生日！我要办一场派对，爸爸还要表演魔术！快点，乔治，我们去叫醒妈妈和爸爸！

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are still fast asleep. Wake up, it's my birthday! Wake up! What time is it? It's very late! It's five o'clock in the morning! Yes, the whole day is ahead of us! Okay, let's get your birthday started! Yippee!
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸还在熟睡。快醒醒，今天是我的生日！快起来！几点了？很晚啦！现在是早上五点！是的，一整天都在等着我们呢！好吧，那我们就开始过生日吧！太好啦！

lines.en: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and George are giving Peppa her birthday present. Happy birthday, Peppa!
lines.zh: 猪妈妈、猪爸爸和乔治在给佩奇送生日礼物。生日快乐，佩奇！

lines.en: Ooh, what is it? A doll's dress! I can put it on Teddy! Thank you, everyone! You're welcome, Peppa! I didn't know Teddy was a girl! Teddy! Oh, Daddy, of course Teddy's a girl! I love my new dress! Thank you, everyone!
lines.zh: 哦，是什么呀？一条娃娃裙！我可以给泰迪穿上！谢谢大家！不客气，佩奇！我还不知道泰迪是女孩子呢！泰迪！哦，爸爸，泰迪当然是女孩子啦！我喜欢我的新裙子！谢谢大家！

lines.en: You're welcome, Teddy, don't get it dirty! Do you know what's happening next, Peppa?
lines.zh: 不客气，泰迪，别把它弄脏了！佩奇，你知道接下来要做什么吗？

lines.en: Yes, my friends are coming for my birthday party, and Daddy's doing a magic show! No one will know the magician is your daddy. You will introduce me as the amazing Mysterio! The amazing Mysterio? Yes, the amazing Mysterio!
lines.zh: 知道，我的朋友们要来参加我的生日派对，爸爸还要表演魔术！没人会知道那个魔术师就是你爸爸。你要把我介绍成神奇的大魔术师！神奇的大魔术师？对，神奇的大魔术师！

lines.en: Daddy's been practising his magic tricks all week!
lines.zh: 爸爸练了整整一个星期的魔术！

lines.en: My friends are here! Yippee! Here are Peppa's friends: Candy Cat, Suzy Sheep, Danny Dog, Rebecca Rabbit and Pedro Pony. Hello, everyone!
lines.zh: 我的朋友们来啦！太好啦！佩奇的朋友们来了：小猫坎迪、小羊苏西、小狗丹尼、小兔瑞贝卡和小马佩德罗。大家好！

lines.en: Happy birthday! Come on, children, the party is starting! Hooray!
lines.zh: 生日快乐！来吧，孩子们，派对开始啦！太好啦！

lines.en: Daddy Pig is going to do a magic show. Peppa, remember what you have to say. Ladies and gentlemen, introducing the amazing Mysterio!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸要表演魔术了。佩奇，记住你该说的话。女士们先生们，有请神奇的大魔术师！

lines.en: Okay, Daddy! Ladies and gentlemen... uh, it's magic Daddy!
lines.zh: 好的，爸爸！女士们先生们……呃，是魔术师爸爸！

lines.en: Ho, ho! For my first trick... abracadabra!
lines.zh: 呵呵！我的第一个魔术……阿布拉卡达布拉！

lines.en: Wow! It's Teddy!
lines.zh: 哇！是泰迪！

lines.en: For my next trick, I need a helper from the audience! Me! Me! I just need one young lady. You put your hand up first! Can you tell the audience your name? Susie Sheep!
lines.zh: 我的下一个魔术，需要从观众里请一位助手！我！我！我只需要一位小姑娘。你第一个举的手！能告诉观众你叫什么名字吗？小羊苏西！

lines.en: Okay, Susie, here are three balls: a red one, a blue one, and a yellow one! Okay! Okay! You have to secretly choose one while my back is turned. Okay! Have you chosen one? Yes! Abracadabra! You chose yellow! No! Uh... abracadabra! Blue! No! Abracadabra! Red! Yes! It is red! Hooray!
lines.zh: 好的，苏西，这里有三个球：一个红的、一个蓝的，还有一个黄的！好的！好的！趁我背过身去，你要偷偷选一个。好的！你选好了吗？选好了！阿布拉卡达布拉！你选的是黄色！不对！呃……阿布拉卡达布拉！蓝色！不对！阿布拉卡达布拉！红色！对啦！就是红色！太好啦！

lines.en: Silly magic Daddy, you said all three colours! Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone!
lines.zh: 傻乎乎的魔术师爸爸，你把三个颜色全说了一遍！嘘，佩奇，别告诉别人！

lines.en: Would you like one more trick? Yes, please! Close your eyes! No looking! Say the magic words! Abracadabra! Abracadabra! Open your eyes! Oh! Hooray!
lines.zh: 你们还想再看一个魔术吗？想！请闭上眼睛！不许偷看！说出咒语！阿布拉卡达布拉！阿布拉卡达布拉！睁开眼睛吧！哦！太好啦！

lines.en: My birthday cake! Blow the candles out, Peppa! Hooray!
lines.zh: 我的生日蛋糕！佩奇，把蜡烛吹灭！太好啦！

lines.en: Happy birthday, Peppa! Thank you, everyone! This is my best birthday ever!
lines.zh: 生日快乐，佩奇！谢谢大家！这是我过得最棒的一个生日！
